items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: we had left the Mother Collins Club and moved down to the next block.

ctx.x: she was young and pretty. So one night we were -- we had left the Mother Collins Club and moved down to the next block.
You said Mother Collins or Mother Kelly?

Mother Kelly's. That's right. I'm sorry. Out of Chicago. And we moved into the Riviera. Well, the band that we followed in there was Chris [Columbus]* and His Blue Flames, and that's where I met Clifford Brown. He was working with Chris Columbus. And Clifford wasn't a great person at that time. He was back in the back, trying to get his fingers together and passages together and everything. He was blowing on his horn between intermission all the time he was on intermission and go right back like we'd never had…
